To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Scrum and a CMMI level 5 company combined are the best combination to get from good to great in software development.

Scrum and the CMMI together provide the following benefits: • 4 times the throughput and 12 times fewer defects than waterfall • A 40% reduction in time to fix builds • A 40-50% reduction in time-to-market • The ability to handle 2-3 times as many customer requests
Scrum and the CMMI can be used to create a system that enables the organization to deliver software at Toyota levels of performance.
